items.description: If you laid every American who died from COVID-19 in a circle around Trump Tower, this is how big it would be. This mashup uses the CoronaTracker API to visualize COVID19 data.
Jozomello TV is a web page that serves Turkish,Kurdish,Arabic,Armenian and Persian music clips and videos. It uses YouTube API and selects videos order by popularity and view count.
RideDog aims to help cyclists find and map the best road rides, mountain bike trails and cyclocross rides. Useful for discovering new routes in your own communities or while traveling.

Gastro is a Google Maps mashup of the NSW Food Authority's name-and-shame lists. It collates the Register of Offences and the Register of Penalty Notices and displays the location of offending restaurants on a map. Source code available.
An aggregator of pizza coupons where pizza lovers can search for deals and coupons for their favorite pizza brands.
A mashup using Alexa traffic rankings to present Open Directory Project links by popularity using tag clouds. Alexa's Free Top 1,000,000 Sites file is used for traffic rankings.
